title: Code Review DAO
abstract: The open-source code review process is upgraded and scaled through the use of decentralized community governance. The code review decentralized autonomous organization (CRDAO) distinguishes itself from legacy system code review competitors through industry-leading code review price discovery, increased speed, community audit, competitive pricing, WEB3 transparency, and accountability. The key distinguishing feature of the CRDAO code review process is its unparalleled ability to apply community code review audits.
